stt.title: Speech to Text Service
stt.description: Choose a recognition service. Short audio keeps the original behavior and supports utterances up to 60 seconds. Azure Transcribe, LLM Speech, and MAI-Transcribe offer additional features and may have different pricing and region availability. [Check Azure region support](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/speech-service/regions).

stt_options.title: Speech to Text Settings
stt_options.description: Configure recognition for the selected service. Only supported controls are shown. Your TTS settings are saved separately.

data_description.stt_language_mode: Use the Assist pipeline language, force a fixed language, or let Azure detect languages automatically. With no candidate languages, automatic mode supports multilingual speech.
data_description.stt_language: Used only in fixed language mode. Enter a locale such as en-US or es-MX.
data_description.stt_endpoint: Use an HTTPS resource base URL such as https://my-resource.cognitiveservices.azure.com. Leave blank to use the existing endpoint or subscription region. This changes only STT requests.
data_description.stt_timeout: Maximum wait for an Azure response. Increase this if an enhanced model needs more processing time.
data_description.stt_text_format: Display includes punctuation, capitalization, and number formatting. Lexical preserves recognized words and may include profanity regardless of the filter setting.
data_description.stt_phrase_list: Help Azure recognize device names, room names, people, and uncommon terms. Enter one phrase per line or separate phrases with semicolons. Up to 2,000 phrases; larger lists may increase latency.
data_description.stt_phrase_list_weight: 0 disables phrase bias, 1 is the normal weight, and 2 gives the strongest preference. Applies to the whole phrase list.
data_description.stt_candidate_languages: Used only in automatic language mode. Enter locales such as en-US and es-MX, one per line or separated with commas or semicolons. Leave blank for multilingual recognition.
data_description.stt_task: Transcribe keeps the spoken language. Translate returns the transcript in the target language for Assist to process.
data_description.stt_target_language: Required for translation. Use a language code such as en, es, or ko, rather than a locale such as en-US.
data_description.stt_prompt: Guide transcription formatting, for example: Transcribe verbatim, including all filler words and disfluencies. English instructions work best. Maximum 20,000 characters.
data_description.stt_transcript_style: Verbatim keeps fillers and false starts. Clean removes fillers and formats speech for readability.

error.invalid_language_mode: Choose a language mode supported by this service.
error.invalid_stt_language: Enter language locales such as en-US or es-MX.
error.invalid_stt_endpoint: Enter an HTTPS resource base URL with no path, credentials, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_stt_timeout: The request timeout must be between 5 and 120 seconds.
error.too_many_phrases: The phrase list must contain no more than 2,000 phrases.
error.invalid_phrase_weight: Phrase list weight must be between 0 and 2.
error.invalid_target_language: Enter a translation target language code such as en, es, or ko.
error.prompt_too_long: Output instructions must contain no more than 20,000 characters.
error.invalid_transcript_style: Choose verbatim or clean transcript style.
